mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.2%) signals accommodative monetary policy, compressing equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of periods with FEDFUNDS < 0.2%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals labor market weakness, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods with UNRATE > 5.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate weakening consumer demand, reducing corporate revenue expectations and driving negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 105.0 (INDPRO > 105.0) indicates robust supply chain conditions during late-cycle expansion, boosting corporate capacity utilization and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >60% of periods with INDPRO > 105.0 during late-cycle expansion, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Consumer price index exceeding 235.0 (CPIAUCSL > 235.0) signals accelerating inflation, prompting monetary tightening and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of periods with CPIAUCSL > 235.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Real GDP growth above 16200.0 (GDPC1 > 16200.0) signals strong economic momentum, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >60% of periods with GDPC1 > 16200.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Non-farm payroll employment below 140000.0 (PAYEMS < 140000.0) signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of periods with PAYEMS < 140000.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 0.15% (FEDFUNDS > 0.15) signals active monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods with FEDFUNDS > 0.15 during monetary tightening, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
